<div class="card-body">
'''Walker Barrage''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウォーカーの猛攻</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットが搭乗している自分のＡＴ－ＡＴが位置にいるなら、同じ位置か屋外の隣接位置にある固定兵器を目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＋1＞没収値なら目標はロストする。さらに運命数＋1＞6なら目標と同じ位置にいる相手のキャラクターも1名ロストする（複数いるなら無作為に選ぶ）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Walker-Barrage-PSA-88099884.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴに満載された兵員が実際に外に出て敵と交戦する前に、ウォーカーは反乱分子の防御装置を破壊しておかなければならない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Walker Barrage.

'''Card text:''' If you have a piloted AT-AT at a location, target an artillery weapon at the same location or an adjacent exterior location. Draw destiny. The target is lost if destiny +1 exceeds forfeit. One opponent's character at the target's location is also lost if destiny +1 exceeds 6, chosen at random if more than one is there.

Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon. Lore says 反乱分子 rather than Rebel traitors. Destiny +1 thresholds match the English face.

'''Lore:''' Before the troops packed into an AT-AT actually go outside and fight the enemy, the walker must destroy the Rebel elements' defenses.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese uses 位置 for site and 固定兵器 for artillery weapon.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Barrage]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
